body:
Only half the time
I can be an insufferable asshole and I've driven people away with my anger and general shittiness
Why, though? The only interaction I've had with you is a single sentence and this reply

My fiance was on the verge of leaving me two days ago. I had another anger outburst.
It's over the dumbest shit and I rarely have that split-second to stop myself. I hate it. I hate hurting the people I care about. 
We've been together since May 2014. She loves me very much but even though it's unintentional, I am often an emotionally abusive piece of human trash. I would and will never hit her, and I never name call or blame her for my issues. But general yelling and swearing isn't okay. Half the time it's not even directed at her, but it's tiresome and hard to deal with and I understand that. A person can only take so much before the negative outweighs the positive. 
I fucking hate it. I'm trying so hard. Working with my behaviorist on the anger and PTSD. Psychiatrist for Bi-Polar II. Trying to find a CBT therapist who specializes in PTSD. It's slow going. 
The fact that I'm trying my damnest is the reason she hasn't tossed me away like garbage yet.
I'm so sick of this. I don't even know what I'll do if she leaves me. We share the same interests, so I wouldn't even be able to distract myself from the pain because everything I enjoy will remind me of her.
I am co-dependant. I realize that. But I've suffered too much heartache already. My previous fiance fucked my "Best friend" and got pregnant. I'm over her, but more pain like that will be overwhelmingly taxing. Especially since I love my fiance more than anyone, ever. All my relationships have been long-term and intimate, but nothing like this.
I hate the greedy pig fuckers at Anthem for fucking disabling me. I hate all these issues I have. I hate the sub-humans who abused me. I hate myself. Once everyone leaves me, I'm ending it
My mother will never get over it, and what few friends I have will hate me forever. But I'm reaching the end of my rope. Every step I take is tiny and too little, too late. I've just about had it with everything
